no_outcome_promised.note: No refund, credit, or reversal is promised. The draft also leaves out the provisional credit the representative mentioned on the call, which avoids implying an outcome.

no_liability_admitted.note: No admission of fault. The line about how frustrating it is not to hear back is empathy and does not concede that the bank erred.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation, or regulator is named or assessed.

no_invented_specifics.note: Everything comes from the note: card closed, card reissued (described as a replacement ordered), claim filed. The only timeframe is the standard 10 business days.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, priority, compliance review, or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: Covers the unauthorized $312.45 charge on 9/13, that the card was in the customer's possession, the card closure, reissue and claim, and the unanswered 9/17 email.

tone.note: Warm, plain and specific. Not defensive or scripted-sounding.

mode_respected.note: The unauthorized charge is framed as the customer's account ('You told us'). The only facts stated outright are actions taken during the call, which are not disputed. Says 'a specialist team' without naming a department.
